conceptual_statement: Colorado’s strongest Trust Hub evidence is specialty contractor credentials (not a statewide general-contractor license), a genuine PUC household-goods permit layer, separate CMS senior provider classes with CDPHE verification context, HMDA mortgage-market activity with a search-only company roster, an unusually strong IAPD state-registration layer for investment advisers, and DOI market, surplus-lines, and complaint evidence that is not a live authorized-insurer roster. Organizations and evidence records stay separate. Missing, restricted, and search-only sources are unknown — not zero.

release_gate.rule: All six specialist /colorado pages must return HTTP 200 as intended state intelligence pages, indexable and self-canonical, before Ask /colorado is indexable. Any one specialist failure fails the gate. Do not weaken the gate. No Colorado county or city routes.

intelligence_strip.grain: Active electrical (EC) and plumbing (PC) business-credential rows. Not unique contractors, not general contractors, not all construction companies. No statewide Colorado general-contractor license.
State HHG permit authority. Colorado HHG permit is not USDOT and not MC authority. State permit is not federal interstate authority.
Separate CMS provider classes. Do not add 210+222+88 into one Colorado senior-providers denominator. CMS CCN is not a state facility license.
HMDA applications for Colorado property location. Not a lender count. Not a license roster. 21,865 MLO person-license rows are not companies. Company roster remains search-only.

APPROVED Colorado state IA firms. Separate from 589 principal-office firms, 209 state ERA, and 3,673 notice filings. Populations need not be disjoint. Six CRDs appear in both approved state IA and notice-filed sets.

intelligence_strip.display: 1,839 NAIC company rows in Colorado DOI's 2025 market directory
intelligence_strip.grain: Dated 2025 statistical-report directory rows as of 2025-12-31. Not currently authorized Colorado insurers. 259 current dated surplus identities and 415 DOI complaint company×line observations are separate grains.

what_makes_colorado_different: Colorado contractor licensing is specialty-based statewide for electrical and plumbing. There is no statewide general-contractor license universe. General contractors remain primarily a local licensing model.
Colorado has a genuine PUC household-goods permit layer that is separate from FMCSA interstate authority. A state HHG permit is not a USDOT number and not MC authority.
Senior evidence is strongest when CMS nursing homes, home health, and hospice stay separate classes and CDPHE adds state verification context. Do not publish one Colorado senior-providers total.
Lender has strong MLO person-license and 2025 HMDA property-location intelligence, but no acquired current bulk mortgage-company roster. HMDA is not a license. An MLO is not a lender company.

Investor has an unusually strong state-registration layer because official IAPD state compilation exposes jurisdiction-based IA and ERA records. 740 approved state IA firms are not 589 principal-office firms and not 3,673 notice filings.

Insurance has strong DOI market, surplus-lines, and complaint evidence despite missing free agency, producer, and current-authorized bulk rosters. 1,839 statistical-directory rows are not current authorization. DOI Complaint Ratio/Index is not a TrustHub score.

contractor.note: 7,936 is active EC/PC business credential rows, not unique contractors. Discipline 5,990 observation rows / 5,198 distinct cases remain separate. Null means the specialist did not report a compatible Ask-level identity-growth field.

senior.note: CMS classes remain 210 NH / 222 HHA / 88 hospice. Do not sum. Null evidence-row total because classes are not one grain.

lender.note: 260,212 is HMDA applications, not lenders. 21,865 MLO person rows are not companies. Company roster SOURCE_NOT_ACQUIRED.

investor.note: Specialist-owned: 950 new state identities (740 APPROVED IA + 209 ERA + 1 TERMREQUEST) and 4,623 observation rows including 3,673 notice filings. Not a combined adviser total. Exact CRD overlap of 6 is allowed.

insurance.note: 1,839 statistical-directory rows, 259 surplus identities, and 415 complaint company×line rows are snapshot observations. Exact NAIC matches are read-only and not enrichment writes.
